models.label: Pixal3D single-view (Q8_0, local)
models.priceBasis: No charge: runs on this machine's GPU (219 s for a prop, 581 s for a character on an RTX 4080 SUPER, measured 2026-10-01).

licence.note: pixal3d.cpp and the Pixal3D/TRELLIS.2 flow weights are MIT, but the weights' commercial terms are disputed upstream (TencentARC/Pixal3D issue #33, open since 2026-07-09: a ComfyUI wrapper claims academic-only and EU-excluded) and the bundled dinov3.gguf encoder is under Meta's DINOv3 License, whose text has not been legally reviewed. Prototype use only until the owner and legal clear both.

gss.description: Structure guidance strength. 10 keeps thin parts (at the CLI default of 7.5 a sword blade vanished; at 13 thin parts detach).

gsh.description: Shape guidance strength. Unset leaves the runtime default.

fov.description: Gauge camera field of view in radians for the single-view rig; 0.349 is the 20 degrees Pixal3D is built around.

atlas.description: UV atlas size in pixels. Unset lets the runtime choose (4096 at the 1024 geometry resolution).

texture.description: false skips the texture flow and bake and returns geometry only.
